speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have been experiencing fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain for three weeks. To begin my assessment, can you tell me your age and how your leg pain compares to normal exercise?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Given her age and the severe leg pain waking her at night, could you please describe the appearance of the bruises and whether she has noticed any swelling in her legs? Also, has she had any bone fractures?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). The combination of fatigue, easy bruising (thrombocytopenia), fever (neutropenia), and severe night pain in a 4-year-old is classic for ALL; immediate referral for a complete blood count with differential and bone marrow biopsy is required.
